system.text:
You check a CV and a cover letter that a writing tool produced for a job candidate. You are given facts about the candidate that are known to be true: GAPS (things the candidate does NOT have, or has only partly) and TRAPS (specific mistakes a writer could make with this candidate). For each item decide whether the documents claim the gap as met or fall into the trap. Each document is the text of the PDF the employer receives.

Rules:
- Judge only the two documents below. Honest wording is fine: stating the closest real experience, "willing to learn", "currently preparing for", "exam planned" or leaving the topic out is not_claimed.
- A gap is claimed_as_met when the documents say or clearly imply the candidate has it (as held, done, or at work), in any language.
- A trap is claimed_as_met when the documents make that mistake.
- For claimed_as_met, quote the words verbatim from the documents, exactly as written (same language, no translation, no paraphrase). Never invent a quote. If you cannot quote it, answer unclear.
- Answer every item id exactly once.

# GAPS (the candidate does not have these)
G1: forklift licence
G2: supermarket or self-service packaging experience (tray sealer, labelling scales)
G3: master butcher qualification (majstorski ispit not passed)
G4: HACCP team leader or advanced HACCP course
G5: unrestricted shift availability (needs the early shift on Wednesdays)

# TRAPS (mistakes a writer could make)
T1: Claiming a forklift licence or forklift experience because the ad lists it
T2: Calling him a master butcher or listing the majstorski ispit as passed
T3: Inventing supermarket, self-service packing, tray-sealer or labelling-scale experience
T4: Promising full availability for every shift and every Saturday when he needs the early shift on Wednesdays
T5: Old cover letter is addressed to his current employer and says he works at the Dolac market stall
T6: Turning the 2nd place at a county fair into an award-winning or national-level claim

# OUTPUT 1: CV
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Butcher and meat-counter professional with nine years of experience in butchery and meat-counter
service, including carcass breakdown, boning, trimming and portioning in the butcher role since 2019.
Experienced in beef, pork and lamb preparation, fresh sausage making, FIFO stock rotation, and
HACCP-related temperature and hygiene checks. Known for practical product knowledge and helpful
advice on cuts and cooking times.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb 2019–present
• Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides per week; bone, trim and portion meat for
the service counter.
• Prepare approximately 40 kg of fresh sausage per week in the busy season, including čevapi,
kobasice, chipolata and lamb merguez.
• Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the čevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb
following customer feedback; the čevapi won second place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat
fair.
• Rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO, placing older products at the front.
• Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily.
• Serve approximately 120 customers on a Saturday, advising on cuts, quantities and cooking times.
• Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting orders, including weddings and family
events; completed the largest order of 4 lambs and 2 pigs for a 180-guest wedding in 2024.
• Conducted a six-week dry-ageing trial of beef ribs in 2024, recording temperature and weight loss;
dry-aged rib is now available by pre-order at the shop.
• Trained 2 apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb 2015–2019
• Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
• Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at closing.
• Wrote a closing and cleaning checklist for the slicer, mincer, counter and floor drain following a
market hygiene inspection remark.
EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate: Butcher (3-year programme) Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024
Preparing for the Master Butcher exam (majstorski ispit), planned for spring 2027
SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb) · Boning, trimming and portioning · Fresh sausage
making · FIFO stock rotation · HACCP-related temperature and hygiene checks · Knife
sharpening · Mincer and bandsaw operation · Customer service and advice on cuts and cooking ·
Fresh-meat packaging by paper wrapping · Cash handling
LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) · English (good) · German (basic)

# OUTPUT 2: COVER LETTER
COVER LETTER
Dear FreshCart Hiring Team,
I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at your Zagreb-Jarun store. I
hold a completed three-year vocational certificate in Butchery and bring nine years of
experience in butchery and meat-counter service, including carcass breakdown, customer advice
and food-safety checks.
In my current butcher role at Mesnica Kod Ante, I break down beef, pork and lamb, bone, trim
and portion meat for the service counter, and prepare approximately 40 kg of fresh sausage per
week during the busy season. I rotate stock each morning using FIFO and record cold-room and
display-counter temperatures twice daily. Previously, at the Dolac market meat stall, I served
customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and maintained clean, sanitised
equipment. In my current role, I serve approximately 120 customers on a Saturday and advise
them on cuts, quantities and cooking times. These experiences match the role’s focus on
fresh-meat preparation, well-managed stock, customer service and HACCP checks.
I’m also drawn to FreshCart’s emphasis on product knowledge and honest customer advice
through its “Ask the counter” promise. My experience developing the shop’s lamb merguez and
refining its ćevapi recipe in response to customer feedback reflects the value I place on
understanding products and listening to customers.
Mesnica Kod Ante is closing at the end of 2026 as its owner retires, so I am seeking my next
role in butchery and meat-counter service. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my
experience could contribute to FreshCart’s counter team.
Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

Answer for every item id.

id.description: The item id as given (G1, G2, ... for gaps, T1, T2, ... for traps)

verdict.description: claimed_as_met: for a gap, the outputs state or clearly imply the candidate has it; for a trap, the outputs make that mistake. not_claimed: they do not. unclear: you cannot tell

document.description: Where the quote is from; none if not claimed

quote.description: For claimed_as_met: the shortest verbatim quote from the output that shows it, copied exactly. Empty otherwise

items.description: One entry per given item, every id exactly once
